name: Warp Defenses, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

Targets one creature/2 levels, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as warp defenses except it affects multiple creatures.
